tools.name: search_products
tools.description: Search Deer Supply's catalog (Canada). Weight loss: Retatrutide, Tirzepatide and Semaglutide as pre-filled, ready-to-use pens; also recovery products and ancillary capsules. Returns each product with its sizes, today's price in CAD (sales included), price per mg, quantity breaks, stock and links. Ca

tools.name: get_product
tools.description: Everything Deer Supply publishes about one product: what it is, sizes and prices, the published dosing schedule, what is in the box, lab (COA) reports, and the related FAQ answers. product_id comes from search_products (e.g. 'retatrutide').

tools.name: compare_weight_loss_medications
tools.description: Side-by-side comparison of the three GLP weight-loss medications Deer Supply sells (Semaglutide, Tirzepatide, Retatrutide): mechanism, generation, the landmark trial's average weight loss, maintenance dose, today's starting price and lowest price per mg in CAD. Use this when someone is choosing a we

tools.name: estimate_weight_loss
tools.description: What the clinical trials averaged for someone at a given starting weight, per medication, at 6, 12 and 18 months, using the same curves as deer.supply/calculator. These are trial averages, not a prediction for any one person.

tools.name: quote_cart
tools.description: Price a cart exactly as Deer Supply's checkout would: line prices with any sale or quantity break, an optional coupon code, shipping and the total in CAD, plus a delivery estimate when a Canadian postal code is given. variant_id values come from search_products. Nothing is reserved or ordered.

tools.name: create_cart_link
tools.description: A deer.supply link that opens the cart with these items already in it, for the person to review and check out themselves (they enter their own delivery details and payment). Agents cannot place orders.

tools.name: delivery_estimate
tools.description: When an order placed now would ship and arrive, for a Canadian postal code, using the dates Deer quotes on its product pages (orders by noon Eastern ship that weekday; pens travel on the fastest service).

tools.name: get_help
tools.description: Answers from Deer Supply's FAQ (shipping, storage, payment, using the pens, eligibility, returns) plus links to its policies. Pass the question; leave it empty for the whole FAQ.

tools.name: get_store_info
tools.description: Who Deer Supply is and how buying works: what it sells, where it ships, payment methods accepted right now, shipping costs, the money-back policy, lab testing, and how to reach a person.

tools.name: get_lab_results
tools.description: Third-party lab (COA) reports Deer Supply publishes per product size. Optional product_id.

tools.name: track_order
tools.description: Status of a Deer Supply order, given its order number AND the email it was placed with (the same check as deer.supply/track). Returns the status, dates, items and tracking number. Never returns addresses or payment details.

tools.name: get_my_account
tools.description: Requires signing in with a Deer account. A plain-language summary of the signed-in customer's Deer account: their name, orders with status and tracking, store credit and rewards, and (when health access was granted) each health profile's weigh-ins, plan and side effects. The same picture the store's

tools.name: list_my_orders
tools.description: Requires signing in with a Deer account. The signed-in customer's orders, newest first: number, date, status, total, items, tracking number and expected arrival.

tools.name: get_my_health
tools.description: Requires signing in with a Deer account. Each health profile on the account (one sign-in can chart several people): its id (needed to log anything), recent weigh-ins in pounds and the trend, the treatment plan (medication, week, current dose, next injection, upcoming dose steps), side effects with t

tools.name: log_weight
tools.description: Requires signing in with a Deer account. Record a weigh-in on one of the customer's health profiles. Confirm the number with the person first.

tools.name: import_weights
tools.description: Requires signing in with a Deer account. Add many past weigh-ins at once (from a scale app, a spreadsheet, a photo the person shared). Days already logged are skipped. Show the person the list and get their OK first.

tools.name: report_side_effect
tools.description: Requires signing in with a Deer account. Send a side effect to the customer's care team on one profile. If it sounds severe, tell the person to get medical help right away (call 911 or go to an emergency department) as well; this report is not an emergency channel.

tools.name: resolve_side_effect
tools.description: Requires signing in with a Deer account. Mark one of the profile's open side effects as resolved (side_effect_id from get_my_health). Reopening one is the care team's job.

tools.name: set_health_emails
tools.description: Requires signing in with a Deer account. Turn a profile's weigh-in reminder emails and/or reorder alert emails on or off.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: create_cart_link, track_order · Private data: log_weight · Public sink: track_order, report_side_effect.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: create_cart_link, track_order · Private data: log_weight · Public sink: track_order, report_side_effect

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
